summary: Iteration 1. Backend: 28 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_rentwise_api.py hit the public URL. 27 passed and 1 failed. The failure is a real bug: after-photos are not visible to the landlord or tenant. Everything else in the review request works: auth/role gating, the full repair happy path (agent creates ticket, offer hides address, quote approval, a second decide returns 409, booking reveals the address, mark-fixed, confirm, Pay Hank, ticket closed, Repairs expense in the Schedule E report), the decline path (goes to Sam Patel), self-fix (limit approval, receipt, reimbursement, credit next month), reusing a receipt returns 409, the off-topic pasta question gets a one-line refusal, privacy (Maria gets 404 on Tom's ticket and thread), money (rent paid twice returns 409; bank connect/simulate/assign, cash, expenses, report with deposits_excluded, CSV export), leases (invite, POST /leases), and act-as (works for Tom, 403 for a non-sample user, 403 on approvals while acting). The agent correctly de-duplicates repeat reports of an open issue. Frontend at 390x844: the login screen shows only Continue with Google. Landlord: 5 tabs, approval card with confirm sheet (approved via the UI), property detail, handymen market chips (filter works), Money sheets (simulate, sort/assign with error toast, record cash), Settings Try as Tom, tenant tabs, acting banner and switch back. Tenant: pay-rent sheet (paid via the UI, card changes to All paid), chat quick reply and typed send (contextual replies), tickets, payments. Handyman: Jobs and Profile, accept sheet with day/hour chips (submitted via the UI). test-new-token lands on the welcome role screen. No page errors, no red screens. Deprecated import detected: expo-router/unstable-native-tabs in src/tabs.tsx:4.

critical.issue: After-photos uploaded by the handyman return 404 to the landlord and the tenant. flows.mark_fixed() never sets db.files.ticket_id for after_photo_id or receipt_id, so get_file()'s ticket-visibility branch never matches. The landlord's Pay Hank approval card (after_photos) and the tenant's confirm screen get broken images. The tenant self-fix flow has the same cause: flows.submit_receipt() never links the receipt or after-photo files to the ticket, so the landlord cannot view the receipt before approving reimbursement (same code path, not run live). Reproduced live: landlord=404, tenant=404, handyman=200.

minor.issue: No check that after_photo_id/receipt_id belong to the caller or exist. Any string is accepted for after_photo_id.
Accepts any content type (a text/plain upload returned 200). GET /files serves it back with the client-supplied media_type. Whitelist image/* and application/pdf.
A $3000 deposit on $1000 rent in CA (cap is 1 month, DEPOSIT_MONTHS) is accepted with no warning or flag in the response. Only the frontend (lease/new.tsx:36) warns.
A deposit from a tenant with nothing due can only be marked 'Not rent'. There is no prepay/credit option, so the item stays stuck in review.

ui_bugs.issue: Day/hour chips build the time in the device timezone, but labels are formatted in the property timezone (America/Los_Angeles). The handyman picked '10 am'; the app sent 2026-10-27T10:00:00Z and the tenant saw 'Tue 3 am'. Build slot times in the property timezone.
The not-done action button is labelled 'Done ✓' and looks like a completed state, while the header says 'Get set up · 1/3'. Rename it to 'Mark done'.

ui_bugs.component: Ticket progress bar for self-fix tickets
ui_bugs.issue: A self-fix ticket ('Fix it yourself · up to $60') shows the Handyman and Booked stages as filled. The stages don't fit self-fix.

integration_issues.issue: After-photo and receipt images return 404 (see backend critical issue).

issues: Trade chip reads 'Hvac'; it should be 'HVAC'.
Profile says '1 jobs done'; pluralise correctly.
Feed rows show raw '2026-10-25' while review rows show 'Oct 23'. Use one date format.
The agent-generated reason has lowercase 'room b'.

action_items: HIGH: In flows.mark_fixed and flows.submit_receipt, set db.files ticket_id for after_photo/receipt ids (and validate owner_id == caller) so the landlord and tenant can GET /api/files/{id}.
HIGH: Accept sheet chip times must be built in the property timezone (ticket/property tz), not the device timezone.
Change import in src/tabs.tsx:4 from 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs' to 'expo-router/native-tabs'.
Rename the onboarding utility button 'Done ✓' to 'Mark done'.
Whitelist upload content types; optionally return a deposit-cap warning from POST /leases.
Minor copy: 'HVAC', '1 job done', consistent bank-feed date format.
server.py is 902 lines; split it into routers (tickets, threads, landlord, leases).
critical_code_review_comments: get_file() relies on files.ticket_id, but only chat attachments and agent photos set it. Handyman after-photos and tenant receipts are never linked.
Request bodies are untyped dicts (body: dict) throughout. Use Pydantic models; e.g. float(body['amount']) gives a 500 on bad input in /money/bank/simulate and /money/expenses.
DEMO_FOLLOWUP_SECONDS and APP_NAME have hardcoded defaults in core.py.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows work; slot timezone bug)

seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/sample/reset once mid-run (tokens re-pointed OK). Tests created tickets, payments, bank sims, an expense (TEST_light bulbs) and a Room C invite/lease in the sample home.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_rentwise_api.py -n 0 (MUST use -n 0; xdist is on by default and breaks the ordered shared state). IDs are resolved dynamically via /sample/people. The agent de-dups open issues, so tests cancel leftover open tickets first. The agent may ask a clarifying question instead of creating a ticket, so use specific messages with 'no photo'. In the UI, ConfirmSheet testIDs are <id>-confirm / <id>-cancel / <id>-backdrop.
rca_of_issue: After-photo 404: GET /api/files/{fid} allows access if owner == user, OR files.ticket_id is set and can_see(ticket), OR it is a property photo. Handyman/tenant uploads via /api/upload have ticket_id=None, and mark_fixed/submit_receipt only store the id on the ticket (after_photos/receipt_path) without updating db.files. So only the uploader can view them. Fix: await db.files.update_many({'id': {'$in': [after_photo, receipt]}, 'owner_id': caller}, {'$set': {'ticket_id': ticket['id']}}).
